ترضضن (form I)
# تَرْضُضْنَ (tarḍuḍna) /tar.dˤudˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of رَضَّ (raḍḍa)
# تُرْضَضْنَ (turḍaḍna) /tur.dˤadˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of رَضَّ (raḍḍa)
